goal: Lock Prime Xoah² convergence mechanics and Dark Shadow Dweller resistance
body: New canon clarification from Dave. Existing shard 17776 already locked Terminal Xoah as the end-state after the 1000+ anime arc who loops back and impales/translocates Prime Xoah. Define that action as convergence, not ordinary murder: a Xoah-on-Xoah stab breaches the Veil and opens a localized self-black-hole. The stabbed Xoah's continuity, memory, scars, branch-state and Veil potential are absorbed into a higher-order recursive self, working name Prime Xoah². Route 2 Xoah is the divergent branch that eventually becomes hidden Dark Shadow Dweller / Stage 9 and hunts Prime, but she is not simply the Vol 2 killer. Dark Shadow Dweller is Akuma-class and violently resists convergence because absorption would erase her sovereignty as an independently evolved Xoah branch. This resistance should become a major late-saga fight. Vol 2 may seed black-hole/convergence physics but must not reveal the hunter's identity. Preserve the late Vol 4 / 1000+ anime payoff and Stage 9 vs Stage 10 distinction. Build a clean identity-state diagram, convergence rules, failure modes, and retroactive Vol 2 seeds without spoiling the reveal.
